note: The locked DeepSeek Harness revision this adapter was verified against. The adapter refuses to run against a different revision until it is re-verified; see docs/dsh-integration.md and scripts/probe-dsh-sdk.sh.
install_hint: This package does not redistribute or download the harness. Install the locked revision into a directory the runtime account can read, and point runtime.cli_entry at its lib/bin.js, for example: npm install --prefix /usr/lib/agentos/dsh @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.2
